purpose: Public measured datasets that constrain the BT-HX-Q013 PK/PD separation model (inputs/Q013_model.py).

sources.title: DS-3201b in Participants With Lymphomas (phase 1, NCT02732275) - registry record of the study that the model anchors on

verification.checked_by: curl GET via ClinicalTrials.gov API v2

license.value: US Government work; no machine-readable license field in the API record
license.note: https://clinicaltrials.gov/policy/terms-conditions returned 200 but is client-rendered; the string 'public domain' was not found in the served HTML. Under PREREG F4(a) this source is therefore NOT usable as a redistributable dataset and is used only for cohort/design identification.

n.provenance_of_the_last_three: Tachibana 2025 abstract (PMID 41150706), not from the registry record

parameters_or_outputs: design (single doses of midazolam and digoxin alone and with valemetostat 200 mg QD, 28-day cycle)

sources.key_finding: hasResults = false: the numbers the model is anchored on (digoxin AUClast GMR 1.27, 90% CI 1.06-1.52, n=16) are NOT available as machine-readable public data anywhere in the registry. R_plasma = 1.27 stays literature-only.

sources.title: Differential impact of nevirapine on artemether-lumefantrine pharmacokinetics in individuals stratified by CYP2B6 c.516G>T genotypes

mirror.note: Dryad mirror, same files, checked under this job

verification.checked_by: curl GET against Dryad API v2

constrains.how: measured plasma concentration-time data of a victim drug (lumefantrine) with and without a perpetrator drug (nevirapine) in the same subjects, i.e. a signed DDI ratio that can discriminate the F branch from the CL branch; a CYP inducer gives the opposite sign to the valemetostat/digoxin case, so a dataset that reproduces the frozen F_mult-only branch must be tested against this sign pattern

sources.title: Plasma and breast milk lumefantrine data in breastfeeding mothers with uncomplicated plasmodium falciparum malaria (interim analysis)

verification.checked_by: curl GET of the file content endpoint; byte count re-checked with stat on the saved copy
verification.note: 8506 is the content-length of the CSV file endpoint (also re-checked with stat on the saved copy); 6636 is the record metadata

sources.format: CSV, long format, 11 columns, 195 data rows, 6 subjects

constrains.how: the same subject and the same time base are measured in plasma and in a non-plasma compartment, which is exactly the paired structure the model lacks; it constrains the FORM of C_local (a driven compartment that lags and is scaled relative to plasma) and the plausible magnitude of a transfer ratio, not the numeric k_in/k_out of this model (drug and tissue differ, and PREREG M3 forbids fitting)

sources.title: qHTS assay to identify aromatase inhibitors: Summary (Tox21/NCATS, PubChem AID 743139), concise bioactivity

verification.checked_by: curl GET; the JSON and the CSV variants of the same assay were both requested

license.quote: Information that is created by or for the US government on this site is within the public domain.

sources.format: JSON table (also served as CSV) with columns AID, SID, CID, Activity Outcome, Target Accession, Target GeneID, Activity Value [uM], Activity Name, Assay Name, Assay Type, PubMed ID, RNAi

constrains.how: cell-based dose-response endpoints with an absolute potency unit (uM) exist publicly at scale, and the Active/Inactive outcome is the operational form of a threshold such as Emax; this constrains the FORM and the scale of the B3 block, not its numeric values for this model
constrains.explicit_limit: the assay target is aromatase/CYP19A1, not P-glycoprotein or a digoxin-like target, and the model's EC50/Emax are dimensionless; no numeric transfer is claimed

sources.title: MedPelvis3D: a 3D pelvic anatomy dataset for anatomical landmark detection

verification.checked_by: curl GET against the Zenodo records API

sources.format: NIfTI CT volumes (.nii.gz) + segmentation masks + STL surface meshes + 57 expert landmarks (CSV) + 50,000-point reference clouds (.npy) + per-case metadata.csv
sources.coordinate_frame: all explicit XYZ coordinates in millimetres, patient-level LPS convention; NIfTI volumes and masks keep their affine matrices

constrains.how: the model has no geometric, anatomical or shape parameter; no output of B1-B4 is a function of a pelvic landmark, mesh or atlas
